Hi Stephanie / Ben —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Attached are the initial documents to get Treeline Payments set up as a payee:
- treeline_bank_setup.pdf (bank details + routing)
- W9_Treeline.pdf

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the docs. Quick checklist from our side to finish vendor setup and enable remittance:
1) Please e-sign the Redwood Vendor ACH Authorization (attached) — this gives Finance permission to push ACH to the account on file. We also accept a bank letter or a voided check if that’s easier.
2) Confirm the account type (checking/savings) and whether the remittance email above should be added to payment notifications.
3) We’ve created PO-2027-3841 for the first contract period. Please reference that PO on the invoice.

Doc links: https://docusign.com/embedded/abcdef123456 (vendor ACH auth)

Finance will run micro-deposits to the account after we receive the signed ACH auth. Ben — looping you in to kick off verification once we get the signed form. Aditya — FYI for procurement records.

Next steps/outcome we want: vendor signs auth today; micro-deposits land within 1–2 business days; payments enabled and remittance note set to ap@treelinepay.com.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

I signed the vendor ACH authorization via the DocuSign link and uploaded a copy of a voided check to your portal (see attached ACH_authorization_signed.pdf). Account type: Checking. Remittance notifications should go to ap@treelinepay.com — I'll also enable auto-notify from our side.

Micro-deposit expectation: our bank will post two micro-deposits under $0.50 each in 24–48 hours. I’ll confirm the exact amounts once they appear (we’ll only give the last four digits publicly here: ...4321).

Let me know if you need anything else to expedite.

Best,
